children: American reported New Jersey BPU approval of a $68 million annualized revenue increase and a $9.88/month PFAS credit for eligible customers.
New Jersey BPU approved a settlement granting New Jersey American Water a $68M annual revenue increase effective Sept 15, 2026.
Allowance based on 9.5% ROE, $6.06B authorized rate base, 54.0% common equity and 46.0% long-term debt ratios.
Increase driven primarily by about $1.4B of incremental capital investments since the last rate case.
Eligible water customers receive a $9.88 monthly PFAS settlement credit for 12 months, totaling >$79M returned.
Average residential water or wastewater bills rise ≈$4/month; PLUS credit can offset and produce net reductions for eligible customers.
